summary: Stalled postback reconciler triggered provisional credit hold and overdue invoice notice
description:
Issue summary: Customer (Finlytics Inc., enterprise) received an overdue invoice notice and a provisional credit hold for the billing period 2026-02-25 to 2026-03-03. They report significant metering variance versus their internal dashboard. Support investigation indicates our postback reconciler job stalled during a window of high postback reorder, causing postback aggregation to be delayed and an automated credit hold to be applied by the billing pipeline.

Impact: Finance team at Finlytics reported 1) an overdue invoice flagged in their AP system, 2) a provisional credit hold reducing available trial/credit balance on the org, and 3) downstream SLA alert emails to their procurement team. Customer is asking for an immediate provisional credit and a corrected invoice.

Environment: Production (us-east) dedicated customer tenant. Dedicated capacity, private customer keys.

Relevant timeline/IDs:
- Customer reported: 2026-03-12 10:02 UTC via support form
- Billing notice sent: 2026-03-12 08:45 UTC
- Reconciler job run ID (failed window): reconciler-run-20260312-03
- Invoice ID: INV-FT-20260303-3312
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate a rapid burst of postbacks from regional ingest (multi-shard) during 03:00-03:30 UTC with intentional out-of-order sequence numbers.
2) Force a transient DB lock on postback-queue consumer (simulate high I/O) so the reconciler cannot commit aggregates within the hourly window.
3) Trigger billing pipeline that marks unsettled hours as 'pending' and then the automated credit-hold rule that runs after X hours of missing reconciliation.
logs: reconciler-run-20260312-03: ERROR: Timeout waiting for shard-7 cursor commit (25 retries)
postback-processor:WARN: saw 37 out-of-order postbacks between 2026-03-12T02:58:12Z and 2026-03-12T03:04:09Z
billing-pipeline:INFO: marking hourly-aggregation 2026-03-12T03:00:00Z as 'missing' -> triggers provisional_credit_hold()
console-alert: Billing hold rule 4 triggered for org finlytics-89 at 2026-03-12T08:40:15Z
investigation_notes: Initial triage: postback-reconciler job experienced repeat commit timeouts tied to increased IO contention on the aggregate store (observed spike in RDS write latency).
Hypothesis 1: Out-of-order postbacks plus locking meant the hourly aggregator did not reach quorum and the billing pipeline treated the hour as missing, scheduling a hold.
Hypothesis 2: Clock skew on one of the ingest shards (shard-7) produced sequence numbers that re-ordered messages, exacerbating commit backpressure.
Query run: SELECT count(*) FROM postbacks WHERE org = 'finlytics-89' AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-12T02:50:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T03:10:00Z' -> 18,402 rows (burst).
Confirmed: reconciler-run-20260312-03 ended with non-zero exit code; logs show DB timeout before flush. Postback backlog persisted in SQS for ~4 hours before backfill worker processed them.
comments: 2026-03-12 11:05 UTC - Aisha Patel (Support): Raised to billing/infra. Customer asks for provisional credit while we investigate and avoid AP escalation.

2026-03-12 11:22 UTC - Marcus Chen (Billing): Noted automated hold was applied per rule 'missing_hour_hold_v2'. Preparing provisional credit proposal. Need infra confirmation on reconciler failure window.
2026-03-12 13:40 UTC - Elena Garcia (Infra): Confirmed RDS write latency spike at 03:00-03:10 UTC; we've re-run backfill for backlog and instrumented aggregator to surface commit failures earlier.

2026-03-12 15:04 UTC - Marcus Chen (Billing): Issued provisional credit of $14,250 to Finlytics (reference PC-FT-20260312). Updated invoice INV-FT-20260303-3312 with 'provisional_credit' line. Waiting for customer ACK.
2026-03-13 09:12 UTC - Finlytics Billing Lead (Slack): Confirmed provisional credit received; requested corrected final invoice and a root cause writeup for internal audit.
resolution: Immediate workaround: Issued provisional credit PC-FT-20260312 equal to the disputed amount and updated invoice INV-FT-20260303-3312 to reflect the provisional line item. Customer notified and AP hold cleared.

Fix applied: Infra team increased reconciler commit timeout, added exponential backoff on DB commits, and deployed a backpressure metric and alert (alert ID: ALERT-BILL-RECON-001) to avoid silent failures. Backfill worker reprocessed backlog; final aggregates recomputed and posted by 2026-03-13 04:18 UTC.

Follow-ups: 1) Engineering to land PR #482 in billing-reconciler (github.com/redwood-inference/billing-reconciler/pull/482) to reduce lock contention; 2) SRE to add a job-run health check that fails fast and notifies billing earlier; 3) Cross-team postmortem scheduled in Confluence (link below).

Customer communication: Sent email (2026-03-13 12:15 UTC) with summary, adjusted invoice PDF, and next steps for preventing recurrence. Customer accepted provisional credit and requested the postmortem for audit.
